title: Rekha vs Emanuel on 27 November, 2008

paragraphs.text:
TA No.259 of 2008 1

 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT
 CHANDIGARH.



 TA No.259 of 2008
 Date of Decision: 27.11.2008

Rekha .....Applicant

 Vs.

Emanuel ....Respondent

 ....

CORAM : HON'BLE MR.JUSTICE RAJIVE BHALLA

 ****

Present : Mr.Munish Behl, Advocate for the applicant.


 ....

RAJIVE BHALLA, J (Oral)

Prayer in this application is for transfer of a petition filed by the

respondent titled as "Emanuel V. Rekha" under Sections 25 and 12 of the

Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 (hereinafter referred to as `the Act') for

custody of the minor child from the Court of District Judge, Gurdaspur, to a

Court of competent jurisdiction at Amritsar.

Counsel for the applicant submits that as per Section 9 of the

Act, a petition praying for custody of the minor has to be filed within the

jurisdiction of a Court, where the minor ordinarily resides. In the present

case, the minor's ordinary place of residence is Amritsar. It is further prayed

that as the application for custody of the minor arises, in essence, from a

matrimonial dispute, being defended by the respondent i.e. a criminal trial

and a petition under Section 10 of the Indian Divorce Act both at Amritsar.,
 TA No.259 of 2008 2

the petition for custody of the minor be transferred to Amritsar. The

petition filed under Section 10 of the Indian Divorce Act was transferred to

Amritsar, vide order dated 25.4.2008, passed in T.A. No.144 of 2007 titled

as "Rekha V. Emanuel".

I have heard learned counsel for the applicant and after giving

my thoughtful consideration to the facts noticed herein above, hold that it

would be just and expedient that the case is transferred from the Court of

District Judge, Gurdaspur, to the Court of competent jurisdiction at

Amritsar. In addition, the petition for grant of divorce filed under Section

10 of the Indian Divorce Act has already been transferred by this Court to

the District Judge, Amritsar.

It would be necessary to mention here that despite service, the

respondent has not come forward to oppose the prayer made in this

application.

As a result, the application is allowed and the case filed under

 Sections 25 and 12 of the Act, titled as "Emanuel V. Rekha" pending in the

Court of District Judge, Gurdaspur, is transferred to the District Judge,

Amritsar. The District Judge, Gurdaspur, is directed to forthwith transmit

the file of the aforementioned case to the District Judge, Amritsar, who shall

upon receipt of the case either try it himself or entrust it to a Court of

competent jurisdiction.

Parties are directed to appear before the District Judge,

Amritsar on 16.12.2008.
